## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at s/n,Casa de Campo.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore this 22-hectare park in Casa de Campo, focusing on conservation, education, and innovation. The park includes an aquarium and an aviary.
>
> Conservation efforts extend both on-site and off-site, with environments that replicate natural habitats as closely as possible.
>
> More than 333 species are grouped by zoogeographic criteria, allowing you to view animals in settings like their native environments. The park houses over 1,300 animals, from mammals and birds to exotic fish. See species like giant pandas, Iberian lynxes, koalas, red pandas, Asian rhinos, and gorillas. You'll also see giant tortoises, bald eagles, and Saharan gazelles.
>
> A new feature is IrenIA, an interactive virtual assistant created with artificial intelligence and synthetic biology. Based on a caretaker, IrenIA gives real-time info about species, helps plan your visit, and facilitates park interactions. Additionally, explore "Land of Gorillas" for a virtual reality experience.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €34.60. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 397 ratings and 112 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
